name: Kojin Taxi 3
source:
This time protagonist is a pure villain. He kidnaps girls using fake taxi and confines them in the basement of his house. What's the fate of six girls unlucky enough to get on his way?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這次的主角是個徹頭徹尾的惡棍。他用假計程車綁架了女孩，並將她們關在自家的地下室裡。六個不幸搭上這輛車的女孩，將面臨怎樣的命運？
